description: This file defines the 'Company' class which extends the 'Basic' class, representing a company entity within the SuiteCRM framework. It includes properties for email addresses, methods for saving data, populating relationship fields, generating list view data, and creating export queries, along with license headers and dependencies.

classes.name: Company
classes.description: Represents a company entity in SuiteCRM, extending Basic, with email handling and export functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Company object and its emailAddress property.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the company record, including email address handling and related logic.

methods.name: fill_in_relationship_fields
methods.description: Populates email address fields for logic hooks purposes.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data for list view, including email links.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Generates SQL query for exporting company data, including email addresses.
